name: lipo_charger
title: LiPo charger
purpose: Charges a single LiPo cell from USB and switches the board to the battery when USB is unplugged

parts.quote: "Regulated Output Voltage VREG 4.168 4.20 4.232 V MCP7383X-2"; pins 1 STAT, 2 VSS, 3 VBAT, 4 VDD, 5 PROG (Table 3-1)
VDD: "Bypass to VSS with a minimum of 4.7 µF"
VBAT: "Bypass to VSS with a minimum of 4.7 µF to ensure loop stability when the battery is disconnected"
"IREG = 1000V / RPROG"; "Fast Charge Current IREG 90 100 110 mA PROG = 10 k"
Charge LED from VDD to STAT (Fig. 6-1); STAT "L" while charging, "H" when complete (Table 5-1); the Feather's CHG LED is orange
"An example of a suitable P-MOSFET for most situations is Diodes DMG2305UX"; SOT23 G, S, D = pins 1, 2, 3 (p1, image); "VGS(th) -0.5 — -0.9 V" (p2). Symbol: KiCad's DMG2301L (same SOT-23 G-S-D pins)
gate pull-down: Feather R4 10K from VBUS (Q3 gate) to GND
"a secondary Schottky diode across the P-FET (in the same direction as the body diode) is recommended" (when VBUS has capacitance: C24); same diode as the USB block's D1
battery connector: the Feather's X1 is a JST PH 2-pin; KiCad's through-hole S2B-PH-K (the SMD S2B-PH-SM4 has no 3D model in KiCad 10)

VBUS.note: from the USB-C block; charger input 3.75-6 V (mcp73831 p3)

/VSYS.note: joins the USB block's VSYS (its Schottky D1 from VBUS) and feeds the 3.3 V regulator: Pico Fig. 18

/VBAT.note: battery voltage, for a divider to an ADC pin later

layout.rules: Power path as Pico Fig. 18 and the Feather: VBUS feeds the charger; the battery feeds VSYS through Q20 (drain on VBAT, source on VSYS, gate on VBUS with R24 to GND, so Q20 is on only without USB); D21 across Q20 in the body diode's direction. C24 and C25 at the charger's VDD and VBAT pins. J20 turned so the plug enters from the board edge (its pins at the back, the opening facing away from them).

open_questions: Charge current 100 mA (R22 10 kΩ) suits cells of about 100 mAh and up; the battery isn't chosen: pick its capacity, then R22 (IREG = 1000 V / RPROG, 15-500 mA).

Battery connector polarity: JST PH batteries are wired both ways by different sellers; pin 1 GND and pin 2 + as the Feather. JST's datasheet (ePH.pdf) returned 403: footprint from KiCad's library only.
No power switch: C&K's switch datasheet returned an HTML page; the Feather has none either. Off = battery unplugged.
Pico: "If using Lithium-Ion cells they must have, or be provided with, adequate protection" — use a cell with its own protection circuit.
The USB block's Schottky D1 (VBUS to VSYS) stays: with USB, VSYS = VBUS minus its drop, above the battery's 4.2 V, so Q20 stays off.
